name: orz-markdown
description: Markdown that edits itself. Turn Markdown into one HTML file that carries its own source: .md.html documents that read like a themed webpage and edit in the browser, .slides.html decks, and .paged.html print documents that export to PDF. Includes the orz-markdown syntax reference — KaTeX math, Mermaid and SMILES diagrams, footnotes, TOC, block IDs, and themes.
